weekly_summary.media_format_insights: Reels and high-impact visual formats continue to dominate engagement, with promotional and product showcase content delivering superior engagement rates (10.1% and 8.5% respectively) compared to static carousel posts.
weekly_summary.peak_audience_times: Highest audience receptivity concentrates around Monday evening (18:00 - 20:00), Wednesday lunch window (12:00 - 14:00), and Saturday afternoon (15:00 - 17:00).
weekly_summary.reputation_and_review_highlights: Maintaining an excellent 4.8 rating across 12 new reviews, driven by strong positive customer sentiment regarding fresh artisanal ingredients, unique flavor profiles, and rapid counter service.

editorial_calendar.designer_brief: Crop to 1:1 square. Apply a vibrant, high-contrast color grade emphasizing the natural yellow citrus tones and rustic wood grain texture. Add a subtle, clean brand logo watermark in the bottom-right corner.
editorial_calendar.copywriter_brief: Write an energetic opening post for the week highlighting hand-crafted freshness and pure ingredients. Tone: Casual, upbeat, and refreshing. CTA: 'Stop by and grab your Monday squeeze! 🍋'

editorial_calendar.designer_brief: Vertical 9:16 layout. Center the syrup-making action with dynamic framing. Reserve top 15% and bottom 20% for Instagram story stickers, poll overlays, and text containers.
editorial_calendar.copywriter_brief: Craft quick, punchy story text demonstrating our house-made mint syrup process. Tone: Fresh and sensory. Include an interactive poll suggestion: 'Minty or Classic? 🌿🍋'

editorial_calendar.designer_brief: Square 1:1 framing centered on the iced beverage and genuine customer smile. Enhance lighting to evoke an inviting golden-hour cafe vibe with soft depth of field.
editorial_calendar.copywriter_brief: Celebrate Friday kickoffs with authentic customer vibes. Quote or reference recent 5-star Google review sentiment regarding fast service and thirst-quenching taste. CTA: 'Tag your Friday refreshment buddy below! 👇'

editorial_calendar.designer_brief: Bold 1:1 promotional graphic. High-contrast typography with clear hierarchy for the weekend offer terms. Ensure core promotional text sits cleanly within the 80% inner safe area.
editorial_calendar.copywriter_brief: High-urgency, enthusiastic weekend promo announcement capitalizing on peak Saturday footfall. Emphasize limited availability. CTA: 'Flash this post at the counter for 20% off your second cup! ⚡🍋'

ad_strategy.target_audience: Local foodies, students, and young professionals aged 18-38 within a 5-mile radius of the store, interested in craft beverages, local cafes, and casual dining.
